documents.title: Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results
Board Meeting Outcome for Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Discussion And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended Sep 30, 2026.

analysis.summary: Uniparts India Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 347 crores, representing a 27% year-on-year growth, alongside EBITDA of INR 90 crores and PAT of INR 57 crores. Growth was largely driven by the construction equipment segment, which accounted for 45% of total revenue, while large agricultural equipment remained near its cyclical trough. The company maintained a robust net cash position of INR 190 crores and generated INR 44 crores in operating cash flow during the quarter. Management revised its FY27 top-line growth guidance upward, expecting full-year growth to exceed FY26 levels by a couple of percentage points. Uniparts India Ltd reported total income of INR 3,552 Mn for Q1 FY27, reflecting a 27.2% year-on-year growth, with EBITDA increasing by 55.3% to INR 898 Mn.

guidance.claim: Q2 FY27 performance is expected to be robust and in line with Q1 FY27 levels.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects to comfortably deliver EBITDA margins over 20% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right?

guidance.claim: Revenue from the Mexico business in FY27 is expected to be in the mid-single-digit million-dollar range.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: Uniparts India's Q1 FY27 performance aligned with quarter-on-quarter guidance and exceeded annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 growth to be in line with FY26 growth.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q1 FY27 revenue to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is projected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in Western markets for the small agricultural equipment segment remains measured due to deferred consumer purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: In the Western market, small ag growth remains more measured.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the U.S. and Europe is supporting order visibility in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs view calendar year 2026 as the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, expecting a recovery in 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture equipment sales in India continue to perform strongly, aided by government subsidies.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility moderated channel purchasing in the aftermarket business.
demand_outlook.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure investments in the US and government spending in Europe are supporting demand visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture demand in India remains strong, while unit volume recovery is beginning in Western markets after three years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs anticipate CY2026 as the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with recovery anticipated through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket revenue accounted for approximately 12% of Q1 FY27 revenues and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Aftermarket represents approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: North American construction equipment demand is expected to continue growing in FY27 with H2 performing better than H1.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: European construction equipment market showed early signs of recovery in Q4 FY26 after passing its cyclical low.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: North American large tractor industry volumes continue to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Deliveries from the company's Mexico warehouse are scheduled to commence in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts is currently evaluating around six target acquisition opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects the fabrication segment to become a meaningful vertical over the next 18 to 24 months.
capex_expansion.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule with uninterrupted customer supply.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Warehouse operations in Mexico are on track to deliver to the first customer in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts maintains its capex plans at 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q4 FY26 was INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 reached INR 90 crores, representing a 55% year-on-year increase.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing situation in West Asia continues to put pressure on supply chains and raw material input costs.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs were 33.3% of revenues in Q1 FY27, influenced primarily by product mix shifts.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects its typical material cost to remain within the 34% to 37% range.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts recorded an EBITDA margin of 24% for Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains that a 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable across the business cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: The new wage code introduced in November 2025 resulted in a profitability impact of INR 3.4 crores.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Uniparts holds a trailing 12-month new business order book exceeding INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The construction equipment business accounted for 45% of total revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: The aftermarket segment represented approximately 12% of total revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing twelve-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed Q1 FY27 with a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow generated during Q1 FY27 was INR 44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stood at 139 days of trailing 12-month revenue as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash balance stood at INR 190 crore at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a special dividend of INR 101 crore in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts is actively evaluating acquisition opportunities to accelerate strategic growth.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts declared a special dividend of INR 101 crores in Q3 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividend distributed for FY26 stood at INR 170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts remains net debt free with net cash of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues in West Asia are causing supply chain disruptions and input cost inflation.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff disruptions altered demand dynamics by causing customers to reduce purchasing activity.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners in the aftermarket segment to moderate purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred at the Ludhiana facility's finishing shop during Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainties and elevated input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: Initial deliveries from the Mexico warehouse to customers are targeted to begin in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Mexico operations are planned to contribute mid-single-digit million dollars in revenue in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

management_commitments.claim: The fabrication business segment is targeted to scale into a meaningful business line within 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse operations are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 revenue growth to be in line with the growth delivered in FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts commits to maintaining capex in the range of 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
